Name: connector-target-cycle
Commands:
assign ecPassed to true
wait 2
if "EC Spare Dock" connector target != ""
  print "EC_FAIL: isolated connector target"
  assign ecPassed to false
if "EC Spare Dock" connector is ready
  print "EC_FAIL: isolated connector has a nearby partner"
  assign ecPassed to false
if not "EC Test Dock" connector is ready
  print "EC_FAIL: dock fixture was not connectable"
  assign ecPassed to false
if "EC Test Dock" connector is connected
  print "EC_FAIL: fixture unexpectedly connected"
  assign ecPassed to false
if "EC Test Dock" connector target != "EC Partner Dock"
  print "EC_FAIL: connectable target name"
  assign ecPassed to false
connect "EC Test Dock" connector
wait 5
if not "EC Test Dock" connector is connected
  print "EC_FAIL: failed to dock"
  assign ecPassed to false
if "EC Test Dock" connector target != "EC Partner Dock"
  print "EC_FAIL: connected partner name"
  assign ecPassed to false
disconnect "EC Test Dock" connector
wait 5
if "EC Test Dock" connector is connected
  print "EC_FAIL: failed to disconnect"
  assign ecPassed to false
if "EC Test Dock" connector target != "EC Partner Dock"
  print "EC_FAIL: target name after unlocking"
  assign ecPassed to false
connect "EC Test Dock" connector
wait 5
if not "EC Test Dock" connector is connected
  print "EC_FAIL: failed to reconnect"
  assign ecPassed to false
if "EC Test Dock" connector target != "EC Partner Dock"
  print "EC_FAIL: reconnected partner name"
  assign ecPassed to false
if ecPassed
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: scenario assertions"

Name: refinery-running
Commands:
assign ecPassed to true
wait 2
if "EC Test Refinery" refinery is running
  print "EC_FAIL: disabled refinery reported running"
  assign ecPassed to false
turn on "EC Test Refinery" refinery
wait 5
if not "EC Test Refinery" refinery is running
  print "EC_FAIL: fueled refinery not running"
  assign ecPassed to false
assign ecIronBefore to "EC Test Refinery" inventories[1] amount "iron ingot"
wait 5
if "EC Test Refinery" inventories[1] amount "iron ingot" <= ecIronBefore
  print "EC_FAIL: refinery produced no iron"
  assign ecPassed to false
turn off "EC Test Refinery" refinery
wait 2
if "EC Test Refinery" refinery is running
  print "EC_FAIL: disabled refinery still running"
  assign ecPassed to false
if ecPassed
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: scenario assertions"
